articles.title: Joan Jett cancels remaining 2026 concerts after undergoing surgery for 'fractured vertebrae'
articles.summary: Rock icon Joan Jett, 67, is stepping away from performing on stage following a serious injury that necessitated surgery. The announcement, made by her team via an Instagram post, indicates a required hiatus for the celebrated musician. This significant development will see the influential artist focus on her recovery from the injury.

articles.title: India's strategic liftoff
articles.summary: India's BrahMos missile agreement, exemplified by the Philippines deal, is just the initial move in its strategic push into the competitive ASEAN defence market. This 'opening salvo' signifies India's ambition to become a major defence exporter, leveraging advanced capabilities to meet regional security needs and strengthen defence cooperation among Southeast Asian nations.

articles.title: Silent whales leave a trace
articles.summary: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) uses optical fibres and laser light to measure strain. Submarine cables, equipped with DAS, are already detecting whale calls. This innovative technology provides a versatile platform, potentially capable of sensing diverse underwater phenomena like seismic activity or vessel movements, significantly enhancing maritime monitoring capabilities.

articles.title: Chinese ship spotted 'lurking' near Taiwan's subsea internet cables linking it to the US
articles.summary: A Chinese research vessel was observed lingering near critical Pacific undersea communication cables, specifically the Pacific Light Cable Network. Taiwan's Coast Guard issued a warning for the vessel to depart. This incident raises concerns about potential intelligence gathering and maritime security in the Indo-Pacific region, highlighting ongoing geopolitical tensions and the vulnerability of crucial global infrastructure.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange overnight strikes, leaving seven dead
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine exchanged intense overnight strikes, reportedly causing civilian deaths and injuries on both sides. Local authorities confirmed these casualties, underscoring the relentless nature of the ongoing conflict. This latest violence highlights the tragic human cost and continued cross-border aggression, emphasizing the persistent intensity of hostilities between the two nations.
